design.title: Design system
design.subtitle: The visual foundation every PANTHER section is built on. An internal review page — not part of the public site.

notes.color: Brand lavender #7136C0 is taken from the official logo files. It measures 2.85:1 on the ground, so it is used for fills, rules, glow and large display type only. Small text uses the lifted token.
notes.typography: IBM Plex Sans Arabic covers Arabic, Latin and numerals in one family. Line heights are set generously so Arabic breathes.
notes.spacing: A fixed spacing scale. Gaps between siblings are laid out with gap, never with per-element margins.
notes.border: Sharp geometry. Radius is zero by default — hairline borders carry the layout.
notes.elevation: On a black ground a shadow alone reads as nothing, so depth is a hairline border plus a wide ambient shadow.
notes.glow: The brand's energy. Used sparingly: one glowing element per viewport, never more.
notes.buttons: Only the primary button carries glow, and only on hover.
notes.motion: Observe → Focus → Move → Impact. Fast, precise, controlled — never bouncy.
notes.hover: Anything clickable looks clickable: a border shift, a small lift, or a colour change.
notes.loading: Every operation has an explicit loading state, and duplicate submits are blocked.
notes.responsive: Switch language above to review RTL and LTR. Resize the window to review responsive behaviour.
notes.reducedMotion: With “reduce motion” enabled at the OS level, all animation is removed and content appears directly in its resting state.
